checks.initialResult:
YOUR USEFUL NUMBER

Waist-to-height ratio: 0.50

Risk signpost only: not a diagnosis or treatment-eligibility result. NICE says this adds limited value when BMI is 35 or above.

Using NICE adult reference bands, this indicates increased central adiposity. A ratio of 0.50 is in the increased band.

Useful estimate—not a diagnosis or verdict.

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR REAL LIFE
